//: The DEPLOY config, at the repo root because Firebase refuses a `public`
path outside the directory holding firebase.json — and Forge Web's bundle
(web/dist) and the Companion's PWA (companion/web) are siblings, so no
config inside either one can see both.
companion/firebase.json stays where it is and keeps its own job: it is the
scripts/web-rendezvous-check.mjs pass with --config, and it is what the
Companion's GO-LIVE.md documents. The database rules are named from both,
which is a duplicated path and not duplicated content.
Deploy:  a push to master that touches the browser client    (Forge Web — .github/workflows/web.yml)
npm run web:deploy                                  (the same, from this machine)

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' wss: https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://*.firebasedatabase.app https://*.firebaseio.com https://api.github.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
